Jakli Assistant Professor of Business Administration Assistant Professor of Business Administration Laura Jakli is an Assistant Professor in the Business, Government, and the International Economy Unit at Harvard Business School. Her primary expertise is in comparative politics and examines how information communication technologies shape political identity and behavior. Her dissertation won APSA’s Ernst B. Haas Award for the best dissertation on European politics.
